title: Harry Styles, Sam Fender & Billie Eilish to Headline Glastonbury Festival 2027: See The Lineup
summary: The festival will take place from June 23-27 in Somerset, England.
contentText:
Harry Styles , Sam Fender and Billie Eilish will headline the 2027 edition of Glastonbury Festival .

The announcement on Wednesday (Nov. 18) includes the headliners for the famous English festival, which will host its first edition since 2025, as well as a number of the expansive undercard.

The fest will take place between June 23-27, with the full music program running across Friday, Saturday and Sunday (June 25, 26, 27).

Styles and Fender are first-time headliners at Glastonbury, with Eilish returning after her maiden headline appearance on the Pyramid Stage in 2022 ; in doing so, she became the festival’s youngest-ever solo headliner. It has not yet been confirmed on which respective day each artist will perform.

Cher will perform in the Legend’s Slot on the Sunday afternoon, traditionally held for iconic artists. Previous performers include Lionel Richie, E.L.O., Rod Stewart, Kylie Minogue and the late Dolly Parton.

Joining them on the lineup so far is Massive Attack, Sombr, Little Simz, Chase & Status, The xx, Lily Allen, Ezra Collective and Kraftwerk.

Additional names include Adéla, Angine de Poitrine, Atarashii Gakko!, The Avalanches, Basement Jaxx, Blood Orange, Bonobo, Christine and the Queens, Chvrches, Confidence Man, Crowded House, De La Soul, Dinosaur Jr, Ecca Vandal, Ellie Goulding, Fat Freddy’s Drop, FKA twigs and Flo.

They’ll be joined by Florence Road, Getdown Services, Hot Chip, Jamie T, Josh Baker b2b Kettama, b2b Prospa, Kacey Musgraves, Keo, Kingfishr, King Gizzard and the Lizzard Wizard, Leon Bridges, Lianne La Havas, Lola Young, Mike D, Moonchild Sanelly, Nao, Nia Archives and Primal Scream.

Completing the lineup so far is Robyn, Saint Etienne, Sammy Virji, Sienna Spiro, Skye Newman, Thee Sacred Souls, The Streets, Teddy Swims, Texas, Thundercat, Tinariwen, Underscroes, Underworld, The War on Drugs, Westside Cowboy, The Womack Sisters, Wunderhorse and Young Fathers. See the full lineup poster below and here .

Styles has never performed at Glastonbury as a solo act or as part of One Direction. He has made brief appearances as a punter over the years, and credited the festival’s dance area for inspiring his 2026 album Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally.

Fender last performed at the fest in 2022 on the main Pyramid Stage. He has since released his Mercury Prize-winning LP   People Watching , and broke the U.K.’s all-time record for the longest-running No. 1 single with “Rein Me In,” a collaboration with Olivia Dean.

Eilish has performed at the festival twice. First on The Other Stage in 2019 at the height of Billiemania around the release of her debut album When We All Fall Asleep, Where Do We Go? . Three years later, she returned following the release of her sophomore album Happier Than Ever to headline the Pyramid Stage. 

Glastonbury is already a sellout, doing so well before the lineup was announced. Tickets for the 250,000-capacity event went on sale in October and sold out within minutes. The last event took place in 2025, headlined by The 1975, Neil Young, and Olivia Rodrigo. 2026’s edition did not take place owing to the festival’s “fallow year” schedule which allows the ground of the working dairy farm to recover once every five years.
